definitions.explanation: Doing something in a gentle, careful manner to avoid making noise or disturbance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、そっと⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The baby was sleeping, so I walked softly.

examples.japanese: そっと⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧そっと⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: She slipped out of the room quietly.

そっと⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}した→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧。

examples.english: I quietly wiped away my tears.
I quietly placed the letter on the desk and left the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧、そっと⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I secretly ate the sweets so my parents wouldn't notice.

notes:
USAGE:
そっと is an onomatopoeic adverb describing quiet, gentle, or stealthy actions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- そっとして⟦おく→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to leave alone, to not disturb)
- そっと⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ (to touch gently)
- そっと⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to peek at)
- そっと⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place gently)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- そっと: softly, gently (avoiding disturbance)
- ⟦{静|しず}かに→静かに：18611_shizukani⟧: quietly (without noise)
- ⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧: secretly, stealthily (emphasis on hiding)
